'dir rje sna tshogs rang grol gyi bka' chos tshan gyi larnam grangs ji ltar bzhugs pa'i rim pa bkod par glegs bam/

tei:div.tei:p: 'dir rje sna tshogs rang grol gyi bka' chos tshan gyi larnam grangs ji ltar bzhugs pa'i rim pa bkod par glegs bam/

nya) sa la/ mnga' bdag myang gi gter kha'i gu ru drag po bde bshegs 'dus pa'i las byang sgrigs chags bltas chog ldeb/ 1 nas 154/ dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang bskur bya ba'i las rim lo rgyus rnam bshad dang bcas pa ldeb 55 nas 102/ 'ja' tshon gter chos lugs kyi las bzhi'i sbyin bsreg ji ltar bya thabs ldeb 103 nas 158/ bka' brgyad khro bo rol pa'i gter sgrub chen mo'i phyag bzhes kyi zin bris ldeb 159 nas 196/ bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las rim sa ldeb 197 nas 322/ bla ma dgongs 'dus sgrub cheb bdud rtsi sman sgrub spros bcas bum dbang dang bcas pa phyag bzhes bya tshul gyi sa bcad zin su bkod pa ldeb 323 nas 366/ byang btang la nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad kyi gsungs glegs bam 367 nas 378/ mtha' log bdud 'dul phug pa'i gnas bshad ldeb 379 nas 392/ khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sna tshogs rang grol gyi rnam thar gsol 'debs yon tan mi zad rgyan gyi zos gar ldeb 393 nas 420/ bka' 'bum nang gi brda dang snyan dngags kyi 'grel ba rgya cher bshad pa ldeb 421 nas 434/ theg pa thams cad kyi mchog rab gsang ba bla na med pa 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i don rnam par bshad pa nyi ma'i snying po ldeb 435 nas 568/ bar do spyi'i don gsal bar byed pa dran pa'i me long ldeb 569 nas 690/ rtsa gsum gter 'bul phrin las myur grub ldeb 691 nas 704/ rtse le rig 'dzin chen po sku mi mngon chos kyi dbyings su gshegs khar gnang ba'i zhal gdams ldeb 705 nas 718/ bsngo smon ldeb 719 nas 724/ bka' 'bum ka pa'i dkar chag ldeb 725 nas 728/ kha pa'i dkar chag ldeb 729 nas 732/ ga pa'i dkar chag ldeb 733 nas 736/ nga pa'i dkar chag ldeb 737 nas 740/ ca pa'i dkar chag ldeb 741 nas 750 bcas bzhugs pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig dza yan+tu/ 1) ༄༅/ mnga' bdag gamayang gi gter kha'i gu ru drag po bder bshegs 'dus pa'i las byang sgrigs chags bltas chog bzhugs so/

2) phyogs dus rgyal ba'i thugs rje gcig bsdus pa'i// phrin las gdug pa 'dul bar rab mngags pa// bdul 'dul drag po pad+ma thod phreng zhabs// btud nas de yi cho ga'i las rim bri/ de la 'dir 'gro ba'i mgon po mnga' bdag myang rin po che'i gter kha las byin pa'i gu ru drag po bder bshegs 'dus pa'i las byang phrin las kyi rim pa ji ltar bya ba la/ thog mar dam tshig dang ldan pa'i gdams ngag gis/ gnas yid dang mthun par byi dor legs par byas la sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs bkod pa'i khyad par bag dro par byas te/ gu ru zhi drag gi sku rten byin 3) rlabs can gyi rigs bris 'bur ci rigs bshams pa'i drung du/ dpal gtor zur gsum rin chen 'bar ba'i dbyibs can rdo rje dang me ris mtshan zhing zhabs su pad+ma 'dab bzhi can rgyan dkar dmar gyis mdzes shing brjid par byas pa'i g.yas g.yon du bdud bdud rtsi sman rag dang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong spyi'i gtor ma ci rigs tshogs kyi yo byad/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas ma tshang ba med pa bshams nas/ spos dang rol mo sogs 'dzom pa'i ngang nas sgrub pa po rnams bde ba'i stan la 'khod de rol mos byin phab nas/ gu ru rin po che la skyabs gnas dkon mchog ma lus pas bskor nas mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin gtibs pa lta bur 4) skyabs yul tshogs gsog gi zhing du bzhugs pa mos pa rtse gcig gis skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ na mo/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog ma lus 'dus pa'i sku// rigs kun khyab bdag pad+ma drag po rtsal// yul 'khor bcas la bdag sogs sems can rnams// 'di bzung byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi'o// srid zhi mnyam nyid ye sangs rgyas pa'i don// ma rtogs a 'thas 'khrul pas 'khor bar 'khyams// da ni rang rig rang ngo shes pa yis// don dam byang chub sems mchog bskyed par bgyi'o//

zhes tshig don mthun par lan gsum bya/ de nas yan lag dgu pa'i sgo nas tshogs bsags pa ni/ hūm̐/ dur khrod me ris 'bar ba'i pho brang nas// 'jigs byed chen po badz+ra he ru ka// dbang drag pad+ma bka' yi 'khor dang bcas// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i pho brang du// drags pa pho mo 5) nyi zla'i gdan steng du// dbang drag pad+ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// rngam brjid dgyes pa'i tshul gyi bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya tiṣ+tha lhan/ hūm̐/ skye 'chi gnyis spangs rdo rje' rang bzhin las// phrin las lhun grub sde brgyad dam la 'dogs// sku gsum dbyer med skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// dbag drag pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ hūm̐/ khams gsum sku gsum dbyings su bsgyur ba'i dpyid// dug gsum dbang bsgyur dgra bgegs 'byung po rnams// drag pos bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs// dbang drag pad+ma'i lha la mchod par 'bul// ma hā pu dzaḥhoḥ hūm̐/ bdag ni ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang song ste// dug gsum nyes pas 'gal bar gyur pa dang*// lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa ci bgyis pa// dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la bzod par gsol// hūm̐/ khams gsum srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur ba'i// drag po gzi brjid 'bar ba'i sku mchog gis// 'khor ba gting nas skam la 'don pa'i phyir// dug gsum zhal du gsol la yi rang ngo*// hūm̐/ sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes yin pa'i phyir// pad+ma drag po rdo rje drag po rtsal// 'gro rnams ji srid rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bdag sogs thugs rjes gzigs// hūm̐/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// byang chub lam gyi bar chad bsgral ba dang*// dngos grub ma lus myur du thob pa'i phyir// theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol//

hūm̐/ bdag gis mos gus dad pas khyed sgrubs nas// thugs rje ma chung sngon gyi thugs dam dgongs// smon lam 'brel ba bzang pos mtshams sbyar nas/ bdag dang 'gro kun byang chub thob phyir bsngo'o/ zhes pa de yan gyis thog mar bdag nyid rgyud dag par bya phyir skyabs sems tshogs bsags kyi las rim sngon du btang nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i tshogs yul de rnams skar mda' rgyugs pa 8) bzhin tshur byon nas rang nyid kyi spyi bor thim pa tsam gyi skad cig la bdag nyid dbang drag 'bar ba'i sku ri rab tsam du gyur pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ dmar las me ris kyi me dang mtshon cha'i tsha tsha skar ltar 'khrug pa 'phros pas/ bar chad gdon bgegs 'byung po'i rigs thams cad rdul du brlag cing me dang mtshon cha'i bsrung gur phub pa'i phyogs bcur bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ yig mthing nag bcu 'phros pa sprul pa khro bo bcur gyur pas phyogs bcu'i bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzad par mos la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid drag po'i thugs srog las// 'byung ba lnga dang mtshon cha'i gur// phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun nas phubs// bsrung 'khor gnam sa kha sbyor nang*// mthing nag hūm̐ las gnas gyur pa// sprul pa khro chen 'bar ba bcu// mthing nag rngam brjid khros pa'i sku// g.yas pa rdo rje tho ba dang*// g.yon pa lcags kyu 'bar ba bsnams// 8) dur khrod chas kyi sku ka brgyan// brkyang bskum zhabs kyi dregs pa gnon// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa nga ro sgrog /me dpung klong na 'gying zhing brjid// rang 'dra'i sprul 'khor grangs med bcas// phyogs bcu'i gdon tshogs 'dul ba dang*// mtshams gcod bsrung 'khor mdzad par gyur// hūm̐/ nga ni dbang drag pad+ma'i sku// che ba'i lha rnams nga yi 'khor// 'jig rten dregs pa 'dul ba'i phyir// phyogs bcur khro bo'i sprul pa 'gyed// steng phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng na// lha gdon bsnol ba'i khri steng du// khro bo'i rgyal po hūm̐ ka ra// lha gdon 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// bar snang gdon tshogs mtshams chod cig

shar phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsib steng na// dri za bsnol ba'i khri steng du// khro bo'i rgyal po rnam par rgyal// dri za 'dul la = shar gyi gdon tshogs = lho phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs = gshin rje bsnol ba'i = khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed// grul bum 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// 9) lho yi gdon tshogs mtshams = nub phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs = klu rgyal bsnol = khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dpal// klu gdon 'dul = nub kyi gdon = byang phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs = gnod sbyin bsnol = khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil// gnod sbyin = byang gi gdon = shar lho 'khor lo'i = me lha bsnol = khro bo'i rgyal po dbyug sngon can// me lha 'dul = shar lho'o = lho nub = srin po = khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo mgon/ /srin po 'dul = lho nub gdon = nub byang 'khor lo'i rtsibs = rlung lha bsnol = khro bo'i rgyal po gzhan mi thub// rlung lha nub byang = byang shar 'khor lo'i = 'byung po bsnol = khro bo'i rgyal po khams gsum rgyal// dbang ldan 'dul = byang shar gdon = 'og phyogs 'khor lo'i sa bdag bsnol// khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che// sa bdag 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'og phyogs gdon tshogs mtshams chod cig om̐ badz+ra 10)ma hā kro dha sarba rakaṣa hūm̐/ zhes pas mtshams gcod bsrung 'khor bsgom zhing*/ yang dag don gyi bsrung mtshams ni/ 'khor ba myang 'das kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad gdod nas dag pa chen por lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin la bsrung bya/ srung byed kyi spros pa mtha' dag las 'das pa'i don dran par bya ba ni srung 'khor gyi dam pa'o/ de nas gtor mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bdag nyid drag po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'bags rtsogs bsangs zhing sbyangs/ om̐ a hūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab pa'i don dran pa'i ngang nas/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/

'phros pas ye shes me yis nyes skyon bsreg /ye shes rlung gi mtshan 'dzin bag chags gtor// ye shes chu yis kun rtog dri ma bkrus// om̐ āḥ'aphros mchod pa'i rdzas la thim// dag pa chen por byin rlabs spel sbyang bsgyur// phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyis 'phrul// kun bzang mchod sprin chos dbyings khyab par gyur// om̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ 11) pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shap+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ ghan+dha/ rā sa/ spar+she āḥhūm̐/ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha pū dza āḥhūm̐/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañdza a mṛ ta hūm̐ hriḥthā/ om̐ ā hūm̐ ma hā rat+na dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ om̐ ā hūm̐ ma hā ba ling+ta te dzo ba lit+na ba la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ye swa hā/ de ltar de yan chad sngon 'gro'i las rim yin no/ ༈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i thog mar ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum tshig don mthun par sgom ste/ om̐ ma hā shun+ya ta dzña na badz+ra swā bha wa ad+ma konyahaṃḥ de ltar ma hā shu n+ya ta dzña na badz+ra swā bha wa ad+ma konyahaṃḥ snang zhing srid pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad// ye stong rtsa bral gdod nas yang dag pa// kun bzang yangs pa chen por lhub grub pa'i// de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin blo 'das dang*// de ltar ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i 'gro ba rnams// rang ngo ma rig gnyis 'dzin 'khor bar 'khyams// 12) 'gag med rtsal mdangs snying rjer shar ba yi// kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ris med 'khyams// rgyu 'bras gnyis su 'dzin pa mi dmigs kyang*/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba mi 'gog phyir// lus med rig pa'i ngo bo yi ge hūm̐// dmar gsal nam mkha'i mthongs su skar chen bzhin// de ltar ting 'dzin gsum gyi snying po rgyu'i yi ge las byung rim gzhal yas gdan dang bcas pa bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐ las e yam̐ ram̐ sum̐ keṃ ram̐ sum̐ keṃ ram̐ bhum̐/ yig 'bru 'phros pa gnas 'gyur 'byung rim rtsegs// e las chos dbyings nam mkha' mtha' dbus bral// am̐ las rlung gi rdo rje rgya gram steng*// ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug

sum̐ las zhing chen sa gzhi khyab gdal dbus// keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab zur gsum steng*// ram̐ las bskal pa'i me chen smug nag 'bar// bhum̐ las dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas khang*// thod pa'i rtsigs pa zhing 13) chen ka gdung byas// zhing chung dral drab mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i thog /rgyu ma'i lda ldi tsit+ta pho long 'phyang*// mi ro'i rgyal mtshan skra yi ba dan 'phyar// gsur dud sprin 'khrig khrag chen zhal chur 'bab// rab tu 'jigs pa'i pho brang chen po'i dbus// 'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi lte ba chos 'byung mthil// pad+ma 'dab stong zla ba nyi ma dang*// dregs pa rgyal bsen 'bum phrag bsgyel ba'i steng*// bdag gi rig pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ de babs// hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcu'i zhing du 'phros// rgyal ba kun mchod byin rlabs hūm̐ la 'dus// 'od 'phros khams gsum skye 'gro'i las nyon sbyang*// rgyal 'gong dam sri 'byung po rdul du brlag /the'u rang 'byung po'i rnam shes gzhob tu bsreg /'od zer tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim pa yis// bdag nyid dbang 14) drag pad+ma thod phreng sku/ /ri rab lta bu sku che yan lag rag /sku mdog mgar gyi lcags bsreg 'bar ba 'dra// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs ni dor stabs bzhengs// spyan gsum gdangs mig nyi zla'i 'od bzhin 'bar// zhal bgrad ljags 'dril mche ba gangs ri 'dra// dbu skra kham nag nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phyo// thod skam rin chen rtse bran dar dpyangs bcings// snyan rgyan mgur chu phyag zhabs sku lus kun// rin chen rus rgyan sbrul chun spel bas brgyan// ko rlon g.yang gzhi stag sham mgo 'phreng dang*// thal zhag khrag gis byugs shing khro chas rdzogs// g.yas pa'i phyag gis gser rdor rtse dgu 'phyar// de las gnam lcags thog gi tsha tsha 'phro/ phyag g.yas sdig mdzub lcags sdig mgo dgu 'gyed// de las sprul pa'i sprul pa'i lcags sdig grangs med 'phro// rngams 'jigs khro gtum

15) pad+ma drag po yi// dbu gtsug khyung nag me yi gshog rlabs lding*// rwa bar nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od 'khyil du// rigs bdag snang mtha' tshe dpag med pa bzhugs// bdag gi dung khang sku yi lha mchog ni// 'jam dpal ser nag ral gri sdigs mdzub can// mgrin par gsung gi dbang phyug rta mgrin dmar// dbyig tho sdig mdzub spyi bor rta mgos mtshan// thugs kar gsang bdag mthing nag phyag g.yas kyis// lcags rdor gdengs shing g.yon pa sdigs mdzub bsgrengs// lte bar mkha' 'gro dmar mo gri thod bsnams// kha ṭ+waṃ rus rgyan rigs bzhi mkha' 'gros bskor// gsang gsan yak+sha me dbal sku mdog nag g.yas g.yon rdorje'i tho ba me zhags 'dzin// kun kyang khro chas yongs rdzogs dor stabs 'gying*// gzhan yang mtha' skor phyi rim thams cad du// rgyud sde bzhi drug 16) dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rgya mtsho'i tshogs// nyi ma dang ni 'od zer ji bzhin bzhugs// steng gi nam mkhar pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// rtsa rgyud bla ma sprin bzhin gtibs nas bzhugs// de ltar rang rig rol rtsal lha tshogs kun// snang la rang bzhin med par chu zla'i gar// ye shes sgyu ma rol ba chen po yi// gnas gsum 'bru gsum dag las 'od 'phros pas/

/ye shes sems dpa'i thugs dam rgyud bskul gyur// de lta bu'i lha rnams ye nas rang sems dang tha dad med kyang gnas skabs gnyis 'dzin gyi bag chags sbyong phyir dbyings nas spyan drangs pa ni/ tshil chen gu gul sbyar ba'i spos dud rkang gling thod rnga sogs rol mo'i sgra dang*/ mos gus gdung shugs drag po ba spu g.yo zhing mchi ma 'khrugs nus pa bskyed de snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis/ hūm̐/ dur khrod me ri smug nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// stong gsum dregs pa 'dul mdzad pad+ma thod phreng sku// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings 17) nas bzhengs// 'gro ba rnams kyi don la sku bzhengs 'tshal// 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho klong nas bzhengs// phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshub pa'i klong nas bzhengs/ /drag po'i las la gnas pa'i spyan 'dren na// dgra bgegs 'byung po 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol// rak+sha srin po 'dul phyir= 'chi bdag gshin rje 'dul = 'jig rten dregs pa 'dul = sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul = rgyal 'gong bsen me 'dul = bdud dang mu stegs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol// zhes spyan drangs pas/ lho nub rnga yab gling nas gu ru pad+ma thod phreng dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas 18) te bya rgod khyu lding bzhin byon par dmigs la/ hūm̐/ dur khrod me ris smug nag 'bar ba'i pho brang na// 'jigs byed che mchog pad+ma 'byung gnas sku// dgra gegs srin po bsnol ba'i khri steng du// nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gdan steng 'dir// bdag dang gnyis su med par bzhugs su gsol// zhes pa dam ye gnyis med du 'dres par bsam/ hūm̐/ rang byung lhun grub pad+ma 'byung gnas sku// dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs las sprul// mthu rtsal rmad byung pad+ma he ru ka// lha srin dregs pa 'dul ba'i mthu mnga' ba// dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo//

zhes pas rang las sprul pa'i lha mo grangs med pas phyag 'tshal zhing*/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba dmigs la/ hūm̐/ snang srid snod bcud dngos por gyur tshad kun// kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin bla na med// me tog bdug spos mar me zhal zas dri// rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// yab yum thabs shes lhan skyes bde ba'i mchog /rtsa 19)brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta// 'khor ba rgyu rkyen rtsad gcod rak+ta dang*// dam rjas rgyan gyi gtor ma brjid ldan bcas// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i bye brag kun// dbang drag lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// mchod yul mchod bya mchod byed ro mnyam par/ /'khor 'das mnyam nyid chen por bzhes su gsol// ma hā sarba pu dza pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐/ hūm̐/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// byang chub sgrub la bar chad byed pa'i rigs// gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs la sogs// drag pos bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs// dbang drag pad+ma'i lha la mchod par 'bul// ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ de nas gu ru pad+ma drag po'i lha tshogs rnams la che ba'i yon tan la 20) bsam zhing dang ba'i yid kyis bstod par bya ste/ hūm̐/ khams gsum gnas na stobs ldan rdzu 'phrul can// nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams na// snang ba mtha' yas sku gsung thugs las sprul// ngo mtshar rmad byung pad+ma he ruka// mthu chen pad+ma 'byung gnas gzi mdangs can// dur khrod chas brgyad sku yi rgyan du khrol// sku mdog dmar po me yi mdog 'dra ba// spyan gsum khro gnyer sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs// zhal bsgrad mche gtsigs drag po'i rkan sgra sdebs// ag tshom dmar ser bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// dbu skra gyen brdzes thod skam lnga yi brgyan// 'jigs byed khro rtsal rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// drag po pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu la// hūm̐ ram̐ phaṭa gsum rgyu yi rdo rje mtshan// dbang sdud bsreg dang gtor ba'i phrin las ldan// ye shes lnga yi me dpung 'ur 'ur 'bar// ri rab lhun po kun kyang

21) thang la bsnyil// gnam thel dkar po rnams kyi klad pa 'joms// pe har srog bdag rgyal po rdul du rlog /phyag g.yon lcags kyi sdig pa 'gyed tshul bsnams/ /rkan sgra rdeb cing spyug klu ku ru ru// rngams brjid stobs ldan kha dgu mig dgu bgrad// tsha tsha 'phro zhing mi sdug gzugs can ma// ye shes lnga yi me dpung 'tshubs shing 'bar// byang chub lam la bar chad byed rnams rdul du rlog phrin las lhun grub pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ gti mug 'joms phyir glang chen stod g.yog mdzad// 'dod chags 'joms phyir zhing lpags rked la dkris// phrag dog 'joms phyir gnas su byugs pas mtshan// nga rgyal dbang bsdud stag gi sham thabs can// 22) zhe sdang gzhom phyir sbrul gyi yan lag dkris// dregs pa 'dul phyir thod phreng do shal mdzad// 'dod don rnam dag rang bzhin du mas brgyan// zhabs gnyis brkang bskum dregs pa'i gdan la 'gying*// rngams brjid pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// sku mchog 'gyur med lhun gyis grub bya'i phyir// ya man+ta ka dung khang nang na bzhugs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro tshul 'gying bag ldan// sku mdog dmar ser ral pa'i cod paṇa can// log lta rtsad gcod phyag g.yas ral gri bsnams// thams cad zil gnon phyag g.yon sdig mdzub mdzad// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum sems dpa'i skyil krung bzhugs// dbu rgyan snyan cha rin chen 'bar bas brgyan// sku yi lha mchog srid gsum zil gyis gnon// ya man+ta ka'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// gsung mchog 'gags med lhun gyis grub bya'i phyir// mgrin par 23) dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal po bzhugs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar ba'i mdangs// spyi gtsug dbang gi rta skad 'tsher ba yis// dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad zil gyis gnon/

/phyag g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pas dgra gegs 'dul// thams cad zil gnon phyag g.yon sdig mdzub mdzad// brkyang bskum dor stabs zhing lpags g.yang gzhi can// stag gi sham thabs sbrul gyis yan lag brgyan// pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// thugs mchog skye med lhun gyis grub bya'i phyir// gsang ba'i bdag po thugs kyi dkyil na bzhugs// sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga stangs stabs mdzad// thams cad zil gnon phyag g.yon sdig mdzub mdzad// stag lpags sham thabs rin chen sbrul gyis brgyan// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum stangs stabs 24) 'gying bag can// mthu stobs rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// yon tan 'dod pa'i don rnams lhun grub phyir// mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor lte bar bzhugs// sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pa gri gug g.yon pa thod khrag bsnams/ rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum mchan khung brten// rin chen rus pa'i rgyan lnga rab tu 'khrol// thams cad dbang sdud rigs bzhi mkha' 'gros bskor// ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// phrin las lhun grub mtha' yas khros pa'i khyung*// spyi bo'i gtsug na lha 'dre gnyen por lding*// bya khyung mthing nag me yi gshog pa can// khro gnyer spyan gsum rdo rje'i mchu sder gyis// zhe sdang gdug pa'i klu rnams zhal du gsol// gnam lcags ral pa drag po'i tsha tsha 'phro// rigs kyi bdag po dbu yi gtsug tu brgyan// mi 'gyur rdo rje 'bar ba'i ba spu las// sprul 25) pa yang sprul bya khyung mang po 'gyed// ral gri 'bar ba'i gshog pa g.yas g.yon las// ye shes sbal gyi me sgra 'brug stong ldir// mtha' yas khros pa'i khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod//

hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// dbang drag stobs kyis dgra gegs 'dul ba'i phyir/ /sku yi sprul pa yak+sha me dbal 'gyed// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs tshul khro bo'i sku// sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i 'gying bag can// dpa' bo stag gi sham thabs sku smad dkris// sku las bskal ba'i mi ri smug nag 'bar// klu rnams 'dul phyir sbrul gyis yan lag brgyan// dbu skra ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes/ /gcer bu stangs stabs khro gnyer glog stong 'gyu// phyag g.yas rdo rje tho ba bsnams pa yis// dgra gegs 'byung po rnams kyi gshed du che// g.yon pa rdzu 'phrul me yi zhags pa yis// dam nyams 'byung 26) po rdul du rlag par byed// yak+sha me dbal sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// pad+ma 'byung gnas 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mchog bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas// lha tshogs kun la gus pas bstod bgyis na// bdag sogs khyed kyis go 'phang myur 'grub shog de nas 'dzab bsnyen bya ba ni/ drag g.yo phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub pa las kha tshar gyi bye brag sogs ni sgrub gzhung nyid nas 'byung mod kyi/ 'dir las gzhung rgyun khyer gyi rtsa sngags bzla ba ni/ bdag nyid pad+ma drag por gsal ba yis// thugs kyi lha mchog gsang bdag phyag rdor gyi// thugs kar gser gyi mchod rten bum pa'i dbus// 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar la// sngags phreng me yi mdog 'dra g.yas su 'khor// 'od 'phros rgyal bkun mchod dngos grub bsdus// sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal gsal// sde brgyad dam sri 'byung po rgyal 27) bsen tshogs// lus srog rdul brlag las ngan rgyun bcad cing*/ /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su thim par gyur// om̐ ā hūm̐ hrīḥ.ar tsig nir tsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐ pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ.a ya ma du ru tsa sha na/

sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ om̐ badz+ra yak+sha hūm̐/ rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rā dzā gnod byed kyi snying la ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces me long skabs dang bstun te ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ lhag pa'i lha mchog pad+ma drag po rtsal// 'dzab bsnyen mchod pa phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis// lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa kun byang ste/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog pad+ma drag po rtsal// 'dzab bsnyen mchod pa phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis// lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa kun byang ste// lha dang gnyis su med par bdag 'grub shog de yan chad gyi dngos gzhi'i rim pa grub nas/ gsum pa rjes kyi las rim rnams kyi dang por tshogs kyi mchod pa bya ba ni/ rin chen gyi snod du bshos chen rgyan ldan bza' btung 'dod yon gyi longs spyod rgya cher 'dzom pa 28) stag lpags sogs kyi gdan steng du bshams la bdud rtsi'i zer yas khyab par 'thor te/ hūm̐/ chos sku rnam dag skye ba med pa las// longs sku 'gag med 'od dpag med du shar// sna tshogs sprul sku ma hā gu ru'i sku// dbang drag pad+ma dpal gyi thugs ka nas// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum yig 'bru'i 'phro 'du las// tshogs kyi zhal zas 'dod yon longs spyod rnams// mi gtsang dri ma nyes pas skyon rnams kun// bsreg gtor bkru zhing bag chags sbyang bar bya// badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ am̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ kham̐ shud+dho nyaham̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i// ram̐ yam̐ keṃ dang aḥyig 'phro 'du las// me rlung thod skyed ban+dha'i snod nang du// om̐ ā hūm̐ gi yig 'bru'i 'phro 'du las// tshogs kyi zhal zas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga*// zag med ye shes bdud rtsi rgya mtsho las// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par ru// rgyal ba'i 29) thugs dam bskang phyir byin gyis brlabs// om̐ āḥhūm̐/ ma hā ga ṇa tsa kra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hṛḥthā/ rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa'i bdud rtsi khol// rlangs pa'i 'od kyi rab 'byams rgyal ba mchod// ye shes bdud rtsi bkug nas thod par thim// dam ye dbyer med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// om̐ ā hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ

zhes pas mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab na/ tshogs mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ rol mo'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ nub phyogs u rgyan yul gyi dur khrod nas// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro sprin phung 'dus pa'i dbus// chags bral pad nyi ro yi gdan steng du// rngams 'jigs stobs ldan pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// dus ngan snyigs ma'i 'gro ba 'dul ba dang*// bdag cag rjes 'jug thugs rjes bzung slad du// zhal zas 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren na// thugs rje rdzu 'phrul ldan 30) pa'i sku bskyod la// byin rlabs dngos grub 'bebs cing gshegs su gsol// rgyas pas 'byor pa drug dang ldan pa'i phyir// rin chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang = dbang mchog mos pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i phyir// pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang = drag po mngon spyod las rnams grub pa'i phyir// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i = phrin las sna tshogs ma lus grub pa'i phyir// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs = bstan pa bsrung zhing bar chad bsal ba'i phyir// bka' srung chos skyong tshogs dang gshegs su gsol// gu ru pad+ma sarba dā ki nī/ e la ra li pheṃ pheṃ/ hūm̐/ tshogs khang dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas 'dir// nyi zla pad+ma baṃ chen gdan du gting*// 'phan gdugs blo gros grib yol rgyan gyis spras// zhal zas tshogs khang 'bar ba'i pho brang 'dir/ /dbang drag pad+ma mkha' gro'i tshogs dang bcas// rngams dgyes sa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol// badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+tha lhan/ hūm̐/ mtha' yas sprul pa skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon// phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// byin gyis brlabs pa pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// yon tan 'gran med che mchog he ru ka// dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū ho/ a la la hoḥ de nas tshogs phud so sor bcug nas bshams pa'i dang po ni/ hūm̐/ dbang drag pad+ma 'khor dang bcas pa la// 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/

/gzugs kyi lha mo mdzes pa me long bsnams// brgyan gyi mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// sgra yi lha mo snyan pa'i rol mo 'thogs// snyan la mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// dri yi lha 32) mo dri zhim bdug spos thogs// shangs kyi mchod par 'bul lo= ro yi lha mo zas mchog zhong pa thogs/ ljags la mchod par = reg bya'i mnyen 'jam na bza' thogs// shangs kyi mchod par 'bul lo= ro yi lha mo zas mchog gzhong pa thogs// ljags la mchod par = reg bya'i lha mo gnyan 'jam na bza' 'thogs// sku la mchod = chos kyi lha mo bde stong chos 'byung 'dzin// thugs la mchod par 'bul lo = om̐ gha ṇa tsakra rū pa/ gan+dha/ rā sa/ spar+she/ dharma pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas tshogs phud dang po gtor ma'i nang du'am de'i drung du phul lo/ tshogs bar sas nyams bshags pa ni/

hūm̐/ dbang drag pad+ma'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// bdag cag rnal 'byor dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin// bskal pa thog ma med pa'i sngon rol nas// mtha' ma lus 'di blangs pa yan chod du// ma rig nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas// lus ngag yid gsum mi dge'i las bgyis te// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs dang 'gal gyur pa// zhal zas tshogs kyi 33) mchod pa la brten nas// gnong zhong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags par bgyi// thugs rje brtse bas tshangs par yar bzhes nas// ye shes don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// sa ma ya a a a/ zhes pas tshogs tha ma la gnod byed bstim zhing bsgral bltab bya ba ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams kyi byin rlabs nus pa'i mthu stobs dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa chen pos/ deng 'dir bstan pa la gnod cing sems can la 'tshe bar byed pa dang*/ rnal 'byor bdag cag dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra gegs 'byung po gang yin pa skad cig gis tshogs tha ma 'di la khug dzaḥ hū/ dbang drag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// rngams drag gtum pa'i rang bzhin las// yak+sha me dbal skar ltar 'khrug las byed pho nyas stong gsum 34) gang*/ sgrol byed mtshon cha'i char chen 'bebs// gne+od byed gzugs phung dum bur gtub// lnga phung lha yi zhal du stab// dgyes par rol cig badz+ra a ra li// gti mug sha la chem dgyes par rol// 'dod chags khrag la rdzab rdzib dgyes par rol// zhe sdang rus la krum krum dgyes par rol// dngos grub bar chod byed pa'i dgra dang bgegs// dug gsum sha khrag rus pa'i mchod pa 'di// dbang drag 35) pad+ma khyed kyis bzhes nas kyang*// byang chub bsgrub la bar chad med par mdzod// ma hā māṃ sa/ rak+ta keṃ ni ri ti/ ma hā tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi/ de nas sgrub pa po dpon slob mched lcam rnams la tshogs drangs shing dngos grub blang ba ni/

hūm̐/ dbang drag pad+ma'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// snyigs ma rtsod ldan dus kyi mtha' ma 'dir// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba'i 'gro ba bdag khyod la skyabs gsol yun du mchodabagyi na// ye shes thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs nas kyang*// khyed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thams cad kun// zhal zas tshogs mchod 'di la char chen phobs// dus 'di nyid la bdag la stsal du gsol// 'gyur med sku yi dngos grub = 'gag med gsung = 'khrul med thugs = yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i = phrin las thogs pa med pa'i dngos grub stsol// 36) kā ya sid+dhi/ wāka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ gu ṇa sid+dhi swā/ karma sid+dhi hā/ zhes pas tshogs la rang nyid lha'i rnal 'byor gyi ngang nas rol zhing*/ de ltar lha la phul zhing rnal 'byor pa rnams la drangs pa'i tshogs kyi lhag ma gang yod thod snod che ba gcig tu spungs te dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bur gcig tu bzhag nas sman rag sbran pa la/ om̐ ā hūm̐/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabasapas/ bka' sdod srung ma lhag ma'i mgron rnams ji ltar dgyes pa'i longs spyod phun tshogs su dmigs la/ hūm̐/ dbang drag pad+ma'i 'khor du gnas pa yi// phyi 'khor skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad dang*// dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ging dang laṅka dang*// phra man shugs 'gro gshin rje srin po'i tshogs/ /'jigs pa'i lus la rngams pa'i cha byad can// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod cing*// rdzu 'phrul thogs med dpal gyi pham phab bsdud// ting 'dzin drod myul rnal 'byor tshogs khang 'grim// rang rang sprul pa 'khor dang 37) bcas pa rnams// zhal zas tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la// ji ltar dbang ba'i phrin las so sor mdzod// om̐ ā tsiṣ+ṭa/ sarba ḍā ki ni/ ba lin+ta khā hi/ zhes nam mkha' mthong ba'i gtsang sar bskyal zhing snod de nyid bshal ba'i bshal chu yang de phyogs su gtor ro/

de ltar rgyun gyi bskang gso las gzhung ni 'di kas chog tshe/ 'di'i mjug tu bsngo smon shis brjod sogs bya zhing*/ ༈ gal te tshes bcu sogs dus bzang gi gtor chog rgyas par bya ba'am/ bar chad sel ba'i rim 'gro lta bu gal chen gyi skabs su gtor mchod kyang cher bshams zhing*/ ༈ gal te tshes bcu sogs dus bzang gi gtor chog sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir/ gtor ma rnams bskul zhing sman rag bran/ bsur dud rnga gling rol mo'i sgra dngabacas pasalasgrub pa po dad gus gdung shugs drag po bskyed de dbyangs kyi nga ros 'di ltar bskul bar bya'o/ hūm̐/ dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i pho brang nas// rngams brjid stobs ldan pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// thams cad zil gnon 38) srin po'i gdan la bzhugs// chags pa'i skyon bral pad+ma'i lta ba la// thugs rje rmad byung zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// nyon mongs 'dam skam nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs// ma bcos rang byung hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las// bden pa'i stobs rgyas byin rlabs tsha tsha khol// 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs rnams tshar gcad nas// gsung gi dbang phyug he ru ka yi sku// dpal la sgeg pa'i cha lugs gsal bar ldan// rngams la brjid pa'i khro bo g.yul las rgyal/ /gtum la 'jigs pa'i khrag 'thung he ru ka// bdud kyi dpung rnams 'joms pa'i mthu stobs can// che mchog bgegs 'dul pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// thugs nyid klong yangs 'jig rten lte bar bcug dam las 'gal ba'i dgra bgegs 'byung po rnams// rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus nas kyang*// bsad bcad gtub nas sha khrag rus pa 'cha'// khyod ni dus ngan bstan pa'i rgyal lan te// bstan la sdang ba thams cad phung bar mdzod/ /bgegs 'dul pad+ma'i thugs rje dbyings nas bskul// dug gsum sha khrag 40) mchod pa 'di bzhes la// thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma ya// hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// chos nyid mi 'gyur phyag g.yas rdo rje bsnams// 'dre gdon 'dul phyir phyag g.yon sdig pa bsnams// glang chen mi lpags stag sham sbrul gyis brgyan// thod rlon do shal rin chen rus rgyan dang*// dur khrod chas ldan gnas gsum byugs pas mtshan// nyon mongs bsreg byed me dpung klong na 'gying*// chas ldan pad+ma'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul// dug gsum sha khrag =

thugs dam dus la = hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma rdo rje = sku dbang rdzogs phyir 'jam dpal dbu la bzhugs// gsung dbang rdzogs phyir rta mgrin mgrin par bzhugs// thugs dbang rdzogs phyir phyag rdor thugs kar bzhugs// yon tan 'dod pa'o don rnams lhun grub phyir// mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor lte bar bzhugs// phrin las rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa'i phyir// spyi bo'i steng na lcags kyi bya khyung lding*/ log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams tshar bcad phyir// sku yi 41) sprul pa yak+sha me dbal 'gyed/ /rnam dag pad+ma'i thugs dam rgyud nas bskul// dug gsum sha khrag = thugs dam dus la = hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma = sku yi gzi brjid 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis// srid pa gsum yang zil gyis gnon par byed// gsung gi nga ro rngams pa'i gdangs skad kyis// khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud par byed// thugs nyid 'byams pa'i thugs rje tshad med kyis// 'gro drug ma lus 'khor ba'i gnas nas 'dren// a ra li yi sgra chen sgrog pa yis// ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du sdud/ hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra chen sgrog pa yis// dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags// stobs ldan pad+ma'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskum// dug gsum sha khrag = thugs dam dus la = hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma rdo rje = spyi bo'i gtsug nas khyung chen sprul pa 'gyed// yang sprul khyung gis stong gsum 'jig rten 'gyengs// ga ru ḍa yis thugs dam dbyings nas 42) bskul// dug gsum = dug gsum = thugs dam dus = hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma rdo rje = dung khang nang nas 'jam dpal sprul pa 'gyaid// yang sprul khro bos stong gsum 'jig rten 'gengs// ya man+ta ka'i thugs dbyings nas bskul// dug gsum = thugs dam dus = hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma = mgrin pa'i gnas nas rta mgrin sprul pa 'gyed// yang sprul khro bos stong gsum 'jig rten 'gengs// ha ya gṝ ba'i thugs dam =

dug gsum = thugs = hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma = thugs kyi sprul nas phyag rdor sprul pa 'gyed// yang sprul khro bos = badz+ra pā ṇi'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul// dug gsum = thugs dam dus = hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma = lte ba'i gnas nas mkha' 'gro'i sprul pa 'gyed// yang sprul mkha' 'gros stong gsum 'jig rten khengs// dpa' bo dpa' mo'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul// dug gsum = thugs = hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma = sku gsung thugs las me dbal sprul pa 'gyed// yang sprul khro bos = yak+sha 43) me dbal thugs dam = dug gsum sha khrag = thugs dam dus la= hūm̐/ drag po pad+ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// 'gro la mgon dang skyabs kyi mchog gyur pa// bdag gi sgo gsum dad pas khyod bsgrub na// dka' ba dang blangs lji ba khur du khyer// lus srog 'ben btsugs sha khrag bzas la bor// mos gus gting nas khyod la skyabs gsol na// thugs rje ma chung sngon gyi thugs dam dgongs// dus ngan snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bdag bskyed na// khyed kyis thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs// bdag ni bla med byang chub bsgrub pa la// laṃ la bar du gcod pa'i dgra gegs rnams// dbang drag pad+ma 'khor dang dang bcas pa yis// thugs rjes drag po'i stobs kyis bsgral nas kyang*// gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i zhal du sbyong*// gsung dbyangs drug cur ldan pa'i mgur du dril// don dam skye med chos kyi dbyings du bstim// nor ba bdag gi 44) 'dod pa'i don rnams ni// dbang drag pad+ma 'khor dang bcas pa yi// grub par mdzod cig badz+ra sa ma yā: zhes bskul nas gtor ma 'bul ba'am zor du 'phang ba gang 'os bya/ de nas gtor gzhong chang phud kyis bshal bar 'bru sna cung zad blug pa om̐ ā hūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs thogs nas sngon gyi dam tshig gi chad mdo dang bstan skyong bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ dus gsum kun khyab pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// ye shes rtsal gyi khams gsum dbang du bsdud// rdzu 'phrul mthu yis lha srin bcud la bor//

gtsug lag khang gi bgegs tshogs dam la btags// lha srin sde brgyad chos skyong srung mar bkod// mya ngan mi 'da' kun gyi gnyen cig pu// mi mngon dbyings nas bdag la byin gyis rlobs// phrin las dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la babs// thugs dam thugs rjes khams gsum dbang du bsdus// hūm̐/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// slob dpon pad+ma 45) 'byung gnas kyis// dam la btags pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon// slob dpon pad+ma phar gshegs pas// mang sprul bye ma'i rab kha der// lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags// nga ni slob dpon rgyud 'dzin yin// khyed ni lha 'dre dam can yin// sngon tshe khas blangs bka' ma bcag da lta rig 'dzin dam la 'da'// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bka' dang dam las ma 'da' cig gtsang gi gan sa chu mig tu// dge bsnyen thams cad dam la btags// nga ni slob dpon rgyud 'dzin yin// khyod ni lha la'adre dam can yin// sngon tshe khas blangs bka' ma bcag da lta rig 'dzin dam la 'da'// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig gnubs kyi ru thog brag dmar du// dri za pho mo dam la btags// nga ni slob = khyod ni = sngon tshe = rgyan gyi 46) bka' dang = g.yu mtsho phyug mo'i nang shed na// pho rgyud thams cad dam la btags// nga ni = byang 'brog dgra yi rdza mgo der// lha btsan pho mo dam = mal 'gro kun gyi rgya mtsho der// klu rigs thams cad dam la btags= rong mdo lung pa nag po der// srin po pho mo= ro ha lung pa khra mo der/ ma yaṃ thams cad = sil ma gtsang gi gangs dkar der// sman dang lha sman dam = kha ri gangs kyi lho brag tu/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis dam = gtsang gi kha rag g.ya' mig tu// the'u rang thams cad dam la btags// nga ni slob dpon = khyod ni lha 'dre = sngon tshe = da lta rig 'dzin = rgyan gyi = bka' dang dam las =

rnal 'byor bsam pa sgrub tu gsol// 47) ces bshal chu de la sman rag 'thor nas nam mkhar gtor/ slar yang gtor gzhong bsrung ba'i 'og tu dam sri bkug cing rta bros mnan pa ni/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i skabs gtor mnan 'di mi dgos kyang*/ gtor ma zor du 'phang ba yin na/ tshur lam sgo khang 'og gam/ lam rgya gram lta bur gtor gzhong gang yod rnams kha grub tu brtsegs pa'i 'og tu e grub gsum nag po gting ring mtha' med du gnod byed dam sri thams cad bcug par bsam zhing*/ bden pa chen po'i nus pa stobs kyis// bdag gis dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri 'byung po gang yin pa de dag thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab chen po'i 'og tu khug dzaḥ de nas rang nyid khro rgyal yak+sha me dbal mthing nag rab 'jigs khro rgyal tshogs rnams gru gsum mthing nag drag po'i mtshon khang der bcug pa'i kha rdo rje rgya gram gyis bcad cing ri rab kyis mnan pa'i steng na khro tshogs rnams rdo rje'i bro brdung bar dmigs shing*/ hūm̐/ gru gsum mthing nag dkyil 'khor du// dgra gegs bsgral ba'i tshogs brgyad la// khro bo chen pos bro brdungs te// sku mdog mthing nag ya la la// gti mug mun pa sel ba'i rtags// stag gi sham thabs nga rgyal 'dul// sbrul gyi chun pos zhe sdang 'dul// g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum drag pos gzir// mche gtsigs snang srid lha 'dre 'dul// rkang pa g.yas pas bro brdungs pas// rnal 'byor pho sri 'dul ba'i bro /rkang pa g.yon pas bro brdungs pas// rnal 'byor mo sri 'dul ba'i bro// rkang gnyis thabs sri bro brdung pas// che sri chung sri 'dul ba'i bro// dpa' bo'i bro brdungs khrigs se khrig dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru// stabs kyi gar byed khyug se khyug sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// mnan don de ni ma ldang 49)

shig bcing ngo de ni ma grol cig dgra ni thal bar rlog pa'i bro// bdud ni phye mar 'thag pa'i bro// gnod byed thams cad rdul du rlog om̐ sum+bha ni um+bha hūm̐/ gṛ h+ṇa pa ya gṛ h+ṇa pa ya hūm̐/ a na ya hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ de nas gtor gzhong rnams yar kha phyes pas sgrub pa po'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin 'phel bar bsam mo/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la nyes byas bshags shing bsngo smon shis brjod bsdu chog bya ba'i las rim ni/ hūm̐/ gu ru'i thugs rje'i bdag nyid dgongs su gsol// bdag cag dus mtha'i sems can rmongs pa'i bu// cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyes tshogs kun// bzod bzhes tshangs par stsal zhing byin gyis rlobs//

yig rgya brjod/ bdag gis pad+ma drag po sgrub pa yi// dge ba 'dis mtshon 'khor 'das laṃ 50) gsum gyi// dge rtsas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// bla ma drag po'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo*// bdag kyang 'khor ba'i mtha' mnyam de srid du// rnam 'phrul rgya mtshos 'gro ba 'dren byed cing*// bstan la gnod pa'i bdud sde dpung bcas kun// rdul du rlog pa'i phrin las mnga' brnyes shog hūm̐/ bla ma rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma lus pa'i// thugs rje'i nus stobs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku// khams gsum zil gnon pad+ma drag po stsal// byin rlabs bkra shis char rgyun gnas 'dir stsol/ /gu ru'i sku gsung thugs yon phrin las sprul// 'jam dpal rta mchog gsang bdag mkha' 'gro lnga*/ me dbal khyung chen lcags sdig khro tshogs kyi// dngos grub bkra shis char rgyun gnas 'dir stsol// yang sprul khro tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// chos srung dam can bka' rdor rgya mtsho rnams// dam med tshar gcod dam ldan bu bzhin skyongs// 51) phrin las bkra shis char rgyun gnas 'dir stsol// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgyas par brjod/ chos dbyings skye med klong ma 'gags med gdangs// ye/shes sgyu mar snang ba'i lha tshogs rnams// slar yang chos dbyings thig le nyag gcig dang*/ khyab gdal kun bzang chos skur e ma ho/ zhes pas snod bcud gzhal yas lha dang bcas pa'i bkod sprul thams cad bdag nyid kyi thugs srog hūm̐ la bsdu zhing hūm̐ yang gyen rdzogs su thig le nā da'i bar du sprin nam mkhar yal ba bzhin dmar por gyur nas/ snang srid thams cad 'od dmar ser cham gdal ba'i ngang du 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag gnyid sad pa'i rmi lam bzhin ye grol blo 'das chen por glod cing*/ slar yang 'od dmar gyi klong nas bdag nyid pad+ma drag po'i skur lam gyi shar bar mos la spyod lam thams cad pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor gsum ngang ma bral bar bya'o/

༈ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams mtha' yas kun// rigs 'dus bla ma kho na'i rol pa nyid// gang gis bla ma bsgrub la rab brtson na// 52) de yis rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun 'grub 'gyur// bla ma'i bla ma khyab bdag thod phreng stsal// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las pa// de sgrub bsnyen cing mchod bstod gsol 'debs dang*/ dad cing mos pa tsam la'ang byin rlabs 'jug /snyigs dus bdud dang 'byung po ma rungs pas// dam chos dge ba bsgrub la bar du gcod// de nyid gnyen po'i lha mchog 'di nyid la// yid gnyis som nyi spangs nas sus bsgrubs pa// bar chad kun zhi bsam pa'i don rnams 'byung*// gdug pa zil gnon lha srin bran ltar nyan// mchog gi go 'phang bde slag 'grub gyur na// thun mong dngos grub 'bad med smos ci dgos// de phyir gtan du 'dun don gnyer skal bzang dag /lha dang bla ma dbyer med 'di bsgrub nas// gnas skabs las tshogs phra mo ma yin par// tshe gcig byang chub mchog don sgrub 'tshal lo// ༈ gu ru pad+ma drag po rtsal gyi bsgrub skor gter kha gong 'og thams cad nas rgyas bsdus ji snyed bsam gyis mi khyab zhig mchis mod kyang*/ 'dir mnga' bdag rin po che'i gter kha las byon pa'i drag po bder gshegs 53) 'dus pa la phrin las las byang gi rim pa sgrig chags su bgyis pa zhig mi 'dug pas/ rgyun khyer ltas chog ma zhig yi ger 'khod pa gyis shig ces/ mdo khams rgya ston gyi phyogs su gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dri ma med pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i bdag po mtshungs pa med pa'i chos kyi rgyal po chos kyi rje chos kyi spyan ldan ngag dbang bstan skyong dpal bzang po'i mtshan gyi grags dkar srid rtser khyab pa gang zhig bkas ring mo zhig nas bskul bar mdzad pa bzhin/ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gdul byar gtogs pa'i btsun pa mkhas mchog pad+ma legs grub rtsal/

ming gzhan sna tshogs rang grol du 'bod pa des chu bo gser ldan g.yas su 'khyil ba'i ngogs kyi sgrub grwa kunalabazang chos gling gi yang dben mtshams mal du bkod pa phyogs dus kun du dge bar gyur cig bkra shis/ 54)
